name: Launch Llama

sources.title: Launch Llama directory — free AI-tools/startup directory claiming 55,000+ founders; Submit button -> /submit; FAQ documents free listings, paid Featured plan, Instant Launch add-on, weekly newsletter features, upvotes, REST API + MCP for agents (/developers)

requirements: Free submission via the 'Submit' button -> /submit — 'Once reviewed, your tool will be listed… completely free. No hidden fees or paywalls'
Product should fit the AI-tools/startup directory audience
Dedicated product page (hero images, FAQs, similar tools, comments) requires 7+ community upvotes and a thumbnail
Paid options: 'Featured' membership (badge + priority placement) and 'Instant Launch' one-time add-on to skip the free review wait — see /pricing
Optional newsletter feature to 55k+ subs is earned via engagement/editorial fit, or paid via /newsletter-ads
REST API + MCP server exist for agents (search catalog, launch-readiness audit, open a listing draft) — agents can't publish; founders finish at /submit
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, URL, thumbnail
Plan to drive early upvotes — 7+ upvotes + thumbnail unlock the full product page
workflow: Click Submit -> tools.launchllama.co/submit and fill the form
Free listing goes through review on a rolling basis (site says daily updates); Instant Launch skips the wait
Once live, drive upvotes/comments to qualify for the dedicated product page and potential free newsletter feature
Optional: buy Featured placement or a newsletter ad
watchFor: Self-described 'world's first full-stack distribution channel' — marketing claims (55k founders, DA72 backlink, GEO/AEO) are unverified; modest actual authority likely
Free newsletter features are editorial picks, not guaranteed
Featured/Instant Launch pricing lives on /pricing — not captured in detail
Young independent product ('by Tom Otto') — treat as a small directory, not a major launch venue
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the directory at tools.launchllama.co/products/<slug>
